title: Dibber 1 — ticket frontmatter
description: The frontmatter every Dibber ticket satisfies (SPEC.md R-DIB-3, R-DIB-5). Keys this schema does not name are allowed: they belong to a repository or a tool. A store may add a stricter item.schema.json of its own.

id.description: A ticket id (R-DIB-4): a name that can stand as the ticket's file name. Which ids a store accepts follows its ids setting (R-DIB-14), which this schema cannot read: under numeric, <PREFIX>-<n> (a trailing lower-case split suffix, R3-51a, is accepted for older ids); under orchestrator, whatever the orchestrator assigns.

ref.description: An id, or a qualified id <repository>:<id> naming another repository's ticket (R-DIB-4).

status.description: R-DIB-6: live (available, in-progress, in-review, deprioritized); closed done (done); closed withdrawn (withdrawn, superseded, deferred).

assignee.description: Advisory: who says they are working on the ticket (R-DIB-5). Never a lock; a coordinator keeps its own record of who holds a ticket (Coordination state).

kind.description: Optional. A file whose kind is anything else is a page, not a ticket (R-DIB-1).
